body:
WHAT
requestSessionList() is also called from onTurnStarted (the first user message is what writes a session to disk) and from onTurnFinished. It sends list_sessions to the tab whose event is being handled (dispatchTabId), so a background tab's turn refreshes its own list and never the focused one's; with no dispatch tab, main routes it to the focused tab as before. The engine answers list_sessions at once, busy or not. The TUI's SessionPicker already asks afresh every time it opens.

WHY
Field test 2026-09-23, finding U-07. The sidebar said "No saved conversations" for the whole 56-minute run and at 19:17 while s_mue8gg2u_5aed60 was on disk: the list was requested once, at 18:03, before the first message.

WHERE
app/renderer/modules/landing.js — requestSessionList(), onTurnStarted(), onTurnFinished().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. (ui) In the real app, a turn_started for the focused tab sends list_sessions to that tab's engine, and so does its turn_finished.
2. (ui) With two tabs, a turn_started for the background tab sends list_sessions to the background tab's engine and nothing to the focused tab's.
